errors.text: The proposed CoCrFeNi-WC system is intrinsically heavy and does not satisfy the lightweight intent represented by the Mg-containing target alloy.
The 1000-1100 °C processing window exceeds the target's 1000 °C upper boundary and omits magnesium-volatilization as the governing upper-temperature constraint.

The proposed BCC-plus-WC strengthening mechanism does not reconstruct the target mechanism involving temperature-induced AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 barrier phases in a dense MgAlTiVFeCo microstructure.
Oxidation and corrosion predictions are not directly supported by the cited WC-composite evidence; in particular, the assumption that WC will not impair passivation is unverified.
The experiment does not compare SPS temperatures or fit biphasic parabolic oxidation kinetics, so it cannot test the target temperature-dependent barrier-phase mechanism.
